name: 分镜换画风
how: 提示词写成「镜头段 + 风格段 + 约束段」：分镜、镜头段、约束段和剪辑代码只有一份，切换的是「画风」——只换风格段那一行，写实摄影、水彩插画、3D 黏土各生成一套图，片子跟着换。
en_how: Prompts are written as shot + style + constraints. The storyboard, the shot and constraint segments, and the editing code exist once; what switches is the art style: change only the style line and a new set of images (photo, watercolour, clay) is generated, and the film follows.
